scope.claim: development-only diagnostic of whether a four-head held-out reference envelope is stable enough to support backbone-ranking comparisons
scope.archive_audit: all 20 target channels and all 60 archived source panels; no model or OverlapIndex fits
scope.budget_curve: the eight source-selected, frozen recoverable targets only, with 100, 200, and 300 training-label cohorts

heads.implementation: continuous_residual_ranking.run._head_estimators and evaluate_heads; unchanged three-fold shuffled training-only GridSearchCV, scoring R2, n_jobs=1, refit=true
heads.reference_envelope: maximum held-out test R2 over the four frozen head families
heads.cv_envelope: maximum inner best CV R2 over the four frozen head families
heads.head_agreement: winner-set intersection is agreement; primary-winner confusion uses the first head in frozen HEADS order as deterministic tie break
heads.bias: per-head and envelope inner score minus held-out score; absolute error is absolute value of that difference

ranking_metrics.topk_ties: all candidates at or above the stable cutoff are included
ranking_metrics.top1_regret: held-out maximum minus maximum held-out value among CV-envelope winners
ranking_metrics.top3_opportunity_regret: held-out maximum minus maximum held-out value among stable CV top-three candidates
ranking_metrics.top3_utility_regret: mean held-out value of stable held-out top-three minus mean held-out value of stable CV top-three
ranking_metrics.material_pair_accuracy: exclude held-out envelope differences below 0.01; score ties receive 0.5 credit

bootstrap.evaluation_rows: unavailable because archived predictions were not stored
bootstrap.unit: target block with all three archived replicate panels retained together
bootstrap.dataset_cluster_unit: five dataset clusters; target means within each dataset are averaged before resampling

budget_curve.selection_status: source-selected after the frozen source opportunity benchmark and before ranker outcomes; no replacement is allowed
budget_curve.union_row_order: replicate seed order 4103, 4201, 4303; within each seed preserve target-cohort row order

seed_derivation.budget_position: frozen budget list position offset by three so new budgets cannot collide with source seeds

budget_curve.pca: row L2 normalization followed by randomized rank-32 PCA fitted on the selected training cohort only
budget_curve.training_decisions: all four unchanged head grids are fit and selected inside each selected training cohort; held-out values are read only after all fits finish

evaluation_bootstrap.unit: paired evaluation-row resample within target; common row indices across candidates, heads, cohorts, and budgets
evaluation_bootstrap.new_200_300_status: stored per-head test predictions enable paired bootstrap

diagnostic_gates.purpose: actionable diagnostic flags only; no gate can promote a ranker or authorize confirmation
diagnostic_gates.point_estimate_weighting: equal target weight after equal replicate/union averaging
diagnostic_gates.point_threshold_rule: minimum gates pass when point estimate is at least the minimum; maximum gates pass when point estimate is at most the maximum
diagnostic_gates.bound_rule: target and dataset cluster percentile intervals are reported separately; no bound is substituted for the point threshold

bound_thresholds.usage: review-only informational thresholds; they never promote a ranker or authorize confirmation

diagnostic_gates.continuation_rule: any failed or inconclusive point gate blocks promotion/confirmation and requires design review; all passing gates authorize only a prospective diagnostic stage
